We need to produce a corrected review according to expected_response_schema. The previous rejected response had assessment APPROVE, issues empty, questions empty, gap_review with material true for all gaps. But the schema requires that for each gap G1..G5, since material is true, we need a question (i.e., a context question). The format feedback says MATERIAL_GAP_NEEDS_QUESTION: we must provide questions array with entries describing missing information and why it matters. Also assessment cannot be APPROVE if there are material gaps. Should be HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED (or REJECT) if there are material issues. According to policy, material gaps require human review. So set assessment "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED". Provide issues? No code issues. Provide questions: for each gap, a question object with missing, why, kind, maybe reference, evidence. The schema for questions: missing (string), why (string), kind (source or schema), reference (optional), section (optional), evidence (optional array). At minimum missing, why, kind. We should include kind "source" for source gaps. For G1, G2, G3, G4 are source gaps? All refer to missing sections/tables. So kind "source". G5 also source. Provide missing description like "Section 10 of the source document is missing". why: "Needed to verify the ice‑class definitions". Provide reference maybe the file and key. optional.

Also gap_review list must have items with id, material: false? Actually we need to assess each gap: if unresolved, we can mark material false and why? In our corrected response, we want to indicate we have questions, so gaps are material but we are posing questions, so gap_review should have material false? The spec: gap_review expects each G with material boolean indicating if gap is material. We have material true, but we will also add questions. The earlier validation error indicates decision issue: cannot APPROVE with material gaps. So set assessment to HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Provide questions entries. The gap_review can remain same but with material true? It's allowed; just need questions. So we include gap_review with same entries (material true, why). Could also set material false after asking questions? Usually still material. But okay.

Thus output JSON with assessment "HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED", issues [], questions with 5 entries, gap_review list same.

Make sure evidence array optional; we can omit.

Construct each question:

{
 "missing":"Section 10 of the source document",
 "why":"Required to confirm the exact wording of clause 1.8 and related conditions for ice‑class assignments.",
 "kind":"source"
}

Similarly for other.

Provide reference maybe { "file":"data/requirements/TRAFICOM_full.txt", "key":"10", "kind":"section"} but schema does not have that field, only reference is string? It says reference is string, maxLength 100. Could put "data/requirements/TRAFICOM_full.txt section 10". But not required.

We'll keep minimal.

Now produce final JSON.
